description: This file is a JavaScript module providing a WebSocket client helper for order tracking in a food delivery frontend. It includes functions to derive WebSocket URL based on environment variables, and to create a WebSocket connection with customizable event handlers.

methods.name: deriveWsUrl()
methods.description: Derives the WebSocket URL based on environment variables or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: createTrackingSocket({ token = null, onMessage = () => {}, onOpen = () => {}, onClose = () => {}, onError = () => {} } = {})
methods.description: Creates and returns a WebSocket connection with specified event handlers and optional token.
